correction_metadata.rationale: Preserve OLFUN-002's nonnegative/principal square-root correction on zero-inclusive Nat and OLFUN-003's consistent x argument, including both transparent notes. Repair only the new MSA note's erroneous description of both square roots as positive: the positive input has two roots, as the unchanged signed formulas and Classical counterpart state. The previous notes and formula/token structure remain intact.

Propagate the Classical distinction between the output function U and computation relation T into MSA. The displayed existential condition treats T as a predicate, not a second output function. Preserve all formulas, proof statements, and the already-correct Classical passage.

Make exact complementation explicit in the first-order P/R gloss in both Arabic registers and the second-order X/Y gloss in MSA. Mutual disjointness alone does not cover the domain; the unchanged biconditional requires all and only the nonmembers. Preserve the already-correct Classical second-order gloss, all domain qualifications, and every formula.

Qualify the MSA Church-Rosser value statement: a normal-form value is unique if it exists; confluence does not assert that every lambda term normalizes. Preserve the Classical formulation and all reduction formulas, including the normalizing versus divergent distinction.

Preserve the existing successor/addition/multiplication corrections and every formula. Qualify compact exponentiation to positive exponents because its zero case reduces to identity rather than Church one. Use the already-present iterated-multiplication term for all natural inputs, with an explicit zero-exponent convention including a zero base and an original-source correction note. Distinguish the operation raising to a power from its exponent argument. Describe pair encoding as the construction used here, not an unproved necessity theorem. Both Arabic registers receive the semantic qualifications without copying register-specific prose.

State explicitly in both Arabic registers that the retained repeated-predecessor term computes subtraction on naturals stopping at zero. The result is zero if the subtrahend exceeds the minuend, otherwise the ordinary difference. Preserve the original Church-pair numeral correction and all constructor, projection, predecessor and subtraction formulas. Log the descriptive wording provisionally instead of claiming a dictionary-attested compact term.

Carry the Classical existence qualification into MSA: extensionality guarantees uniqueness conditional on existence, not unrestricted comprehension. Explicitly distinguish existence from uniqueness, consistent with the book's Russell paradox discussion. This is a disclosed inherited-source clarification; all formulas remain unchanged.

Propagate the Classical nonempty-family and nonempty-index conditions for intersections, with its source-correction explanation. No ambient universe is fixed, so empty-family intersections are not defined by this unbounded membership condition. Union remains unrestricted; no displayed formula is changed.

Propagate the Classical in-general qualification for nonlinearity of the prefix order. Empty and singleton alphabets yield linear prefix orders; the existing incomparable-word example requires distinct alphabet symbols. Preserve all formulas and the arbitrary-alphabet definition.

Propagate the Classical nonempty-subset condition and explicit source-correction note for prefix-closed subtrees. The empty set is prefix-closed but lacks the root required by the earlier definition. A nonempty prefix-closed subset contains the empty sequence as root. Preserve the existing branch-variable correction and every formula.

Propagate the Classical nonempty-set qualification for the existence of a surjection from the positive integers, with its disclosed source-correction note. The empty set remains enumerable under the preceding definition, but admits no total map from the nonempty positive integers. Repeat nonemptiness in the following no-surjection criterion. Preserve every formula and diagonal proof.

Retain OLSIZ-008's reading of s_n(m) as the mth digit of the nth string and OLSIZ-009's two complementary diagonal bit flips, including both keyed notes. Also propagate the Classical implication and strengthening connective: nonenumerability implies no Nat bijection and, more strongly, no Nat surjection. No bijection alone is insufficient for arbitrary sets, as a singleton demonstrates. Replace هو القول with يقتضي and أي with بل; preserve the earlier repairs and all formulas. This is a disclosed inherited-source overstatement, not an invented lexical error.

Carry the Classical scope qualification into the MSA explanation of existential-right and universal-left: the absent restriction is an eigenvariable freshness restriction, not the earlier requirement that the instantiating term be closed. Preserve both formal closedness conditions, the other two rules' eigenconstant conditions and every inference display. This clarifies inherited exposition rather than changing the calculus.

Carry the Classical correction of modus ponens into the shared MSA definition: replace بقياس الخلف (proof by contradiction) with بقاعدة إثبات المقدَّم. The frozen English explicitly names modus ponens and the unchanged displayed schema derives A_i from A_j and A_j implies A_i. This is a substantive rule-name repair for both International and Machrek MSA readers, not importation of Classical register or RTL notation. The selected Arabic term remains provisional and open to expert correction; its mathematical referent is not optional.

Retain the reviewed correction removing the impossible non-index branch, because every natural number indexes a partial recursive function in this enumeration. Independently reproduce and repair the final display's missing Arabic comma by routing the same U+060C through the Arabic text font; mathematical identifiers, arrows and propositions remain unchanged.

Define I explicitly as the identity relation Id(Nat) before it is used to form the non-strict order relations K and H; the immediately preceding identity-relation definition makes this the unique intended referent.

State the cofinite complement inside Nat; correct the triangular-number bound from values below k to values not exceeding k; and replace the invalid claim that an arbitrary injective pairing map has a total enumerating inverse by an explicit ordering and reindexing of its range, including finite and empty cases.

Use one bound name for the characteristic sequence and, under the alternative bijective definition of enumeration, delete repeated values from a surjective image list and reindex the remaining values before calling it an enumeration.

Define closure relative to an ambient set A and a self-map f:A→A, require every intersected set X to satisfy X⊆A and contain o∈A, include zero in the natural-number closure characterization, and use A itself as the guaranteed closed-set witness. Preserve that entire C051-01 repair. Additionally, 0051-P2 (the scope ledger's P0051-02 / scope-0051-generated-carrier) clarifies that existence of a Dedekind-infinite set yields an algebra on a generated subset, not necessarily on the entire original carrier. The proof restricts its self-map to the generated orbit; an uncountable Dedekind-infinite carrier cannot itself be a singleton-generated successor algebra. Only the expository lead-in changes; all theorem and proof formulas remain unchanged.

Carry the Classical final-index wording into both the MSA strong-induction hypothesis and its later application to two prefixes. A formation sequence indexed from zero through n has length n+1, and a proper prefix can have length n while its final index is strictly below n. Metadata findings 0060-P1 and 0060-P2 denote the scope ledger's hypothesis-final-index and prefix-final-index decisions respectively; the second is separately recorded in additional_phrase_choices. Preserve the earlier correct general explanation that one can induct on actual sequence length, the already present syntactic-identity formula, and every displayed bound.

Replace three plural signed-formula macro occurrences in each register by exact explicit dual grammatical realizations: nominative after تكون, genitive after كلتا, and genitive after على in the closure criterion. The closure wording distinguishes identical underlying formulas from opposite truth-value signs. Findings 0067-G1/G2/G3 correspond to the added-nominative, both-genitive and closure-genitive choices, each separately logged for MSA and Classical. Preserve all formulas, signs, every-branch scope, and existing True/And and False/And rule labels. This is an explicit local realization allowed by STYLE_SPEC, not a global terminology-token deletion or a change of calculus.

Propagate the Classical membership condition and its explicit source-correction note: every used assumption belongs to the permitted premise set Gamma, but the finite set actually used need not equal Gamma. This agrees with rule (2), permits unused premises and permits derivations from infinite premise sets. Metadata finding0068-P1 denotes P0068-01 / scope-0068-used-premise-membership in the scope ledger. Preserve every inference rule, axiom, theoremhood clause and worked derivation; the newly copied note is attributed to its exact Classical passage.

Define closure of a subset relative to an ambient set E, with B⊆E, f:E→E, and every intersected X constrained by X⊆E; in the Schröder–Bernstein proof, use A⊆C to regard f:C→A as a self-map of C before taking the closure.
Use B_n, rather than B_m, as the final formula on the right side of the displayed sequent so its length is independent of the left-side sequence ending in A_m.
Restore the omitted negation on B in both candidate conjunction-left premises so their unchanged left context is ¬A∨¬B, exactly as in the proof tree that follows.

Retain the insertion of left weakening and exchange in both branches before conjunction-right, ensuring matching left contexts A,B. Also carry the Classical correction of modus ponens into MSA: the displayed inference A, A implies B proves B affirms the antecedent, not the consequent. Change only the erroneous label إثبات التالي to إثبات المقدَّم; all formulas and the earlier proof repair are retained.

Carry the already-correct Classical rule name into MSA: replace إثبات التالي with إثبات المقدَّم for the explicitly displayed inference A, A implies B proves B, which the frozen English calls modus ponens. Affirming the consequent is a different, invalid inference. No formula, proof step, Classical register, or notation profile is changed; the precise Arabic terminology remains open to correction.

Retain the separate weakening cases in the soundness proof: left weakening changes the antecedent Θ and leaves Ξ=Δ, whereas right weakening leaves Θ=Γ and changes the succedent to Ξ=Δ,A. Also make the introductory failure condition explicit: one or more failed soundness properties suffice, not failure of all three. Replace the ambiguous فإذا لم تتحقق أي منها with فإذا تخلّفت واحدة على الأقل منها, matching the English and Classical scope. This is an Arabic translation-scope clarification, not a defect in the English condition. All formulas, properties and earlier proof repairs remain unchanged.
Restore negation elimination to the introductory list of multi-premise inferences because the proof's later case enumeration already treats that rule and only the introductory mention omitted it.

Choose positive numerator and denominator with minimal sum among all representations of sqrt(2); both the geometric construction and the parity argument then yield a strictly smaller representation and a valid descent contradiction.

Correct the cut-completeness nonemptiness argument, handle multiplication by zero, normalize the real-zero cut, and state subtraction, reciprocal, and division so every field operation requested later is actually defined.

Exclude the zero ring from the ordered-field definition, prove that the sum of two cuts is proper by an explicit rational upper bound, and handle nonpositive members before applying the positive approximation in the square-root cut proof.

Restrict decimal digit values, identify reals with equivalence classes, compare quotient objects with real zero and with class brackets, state the field/completeness results for classes, and correct the bisection estimate to at most one half.
Replace infinite premise sets inside finite sequents by the finite supports actually used, then lift the derived conclusions to the ambient premise set by monotonicity.
State unary and binary rule-premise alternatives without a spurious second index, and define the finite support of a derivation so later eigenconstant conditions refer only to premises actually used.

Standardize quantifier terminology, require each eigenconstant to be absent from the support, side formula, and quantified matrix, introduce an infinite auxiliary reserve, and prove a finite proof-tree eigenconstant-freshening lemma.

Repair the Hilbert proof by composing the common antecedent through implication distribution, explicitly choose its fresh eigenconstant from the reserved auxiliary stock so the quantifier-rule step is licensed, and canonically normalize the Arabic combining-mark order without changing meaning, formula tokens, line breaks, or byte count.
Make monotonicity and proof concatenation valid for quantified derivations by using finite supports and freshening the eigenconstants of the two finite proof trees before joining them.

State the base deduction theorem conditionally: the forward direction is restricted to assumption, axiom, and modus-ponens derivations in the quantified setting, while the reverse direction remains unrestricted.

State the full quantified deduction theorem as an equivalence, cite the easy reverse direction, and complete the formerly omitted existential quantifier-rule induction case with both antecedent commutations made explicit.

Prove strong generalization for an arbitrary constant by finite-support eigenconstant freshening, choosing an unused auxiliary constant, applying a bijective constant swap, then using the quantifier rule and monotonicity.
Retain the representative-independence repair and canonically normalize combining-mark order in its adjacent Arabic audit comment without changing meaning, formulas, line breaks, or byte count.
Retain the explicit arity terminology repair and canonically normalize combining-mark order in its Arabic audit comment without changing meaning, formulas, line breaks, or byte count.

Replace the misleading literal n-local wording for n-ary functions and predicates by the explicit Arabic construction meaning having n argument places.
Retain the proof-code and open-assumption repairs and canonically normalize one Arabic combining-mark sequence in prose without changing meaning, formula tokens, line breaks, or byte count.

Repair the alpha-conversion argument: use the variable removed by the substitution lemma, restore omitted congruence cases, prove substitution compatibility after binder freshening, use strong induction to ensure defined substitution, and require both replacement terms to be alpha-equivalent.
Remove the stray equals sign immediately before the equation label so the aligned derivation has valid relation syntax.
Bind the previously omitted term N in the eta-reduction case before using its free-variable and parallel-reduction conditions.
Describe the primitive-recursion state pair correctly: its first component advances the current index and its second component is the new recursive value determined by g.
Repair the lambda-term bracketing for factorial so IsZero receives both branches and the complete conditional is inside the abstraction.
Repair the Arabic genitive construction for propositional connectives and make the designated-value validity clause explicitly evaluate in the logic L, matching the surrounding semantics.
Use the correct Arabic adjective for propositional constants and define the constant-free fragment L_0^- needed by the later matrix semantics.

Preserve the previously corrected constant-free language. In both Arabic registers, replace only the final exhibited value of not-possibly(p and not-p) at p=Undef by False: negation gives Undef, conjunction gives Undef, possibility gives True, and final negation gives False. The unchanged tables prove this exact RHS correction; the non-tautology conclusion survives. The ledger pins both before/after source identities and each single inverse patch; frozen English is not edited.

Explicitly restrict the finite grid parameter to natural m>=2 in both Arabic registers: the denominator m-1 and intended m-element matrix exclude m=1 and zero-inclusive m=0. This adds one precise inline domain clause per register, preserving all existing grid formulas and the earlier m>0 and n<m repairs. Exact source transitions and formal-change limits are in the ledger; no broad formula waiver or English edit is authorized.

Preserve the corrected constant-free language and the valid forward entailment implication. Qualify only the converse by finiteness of the premise set in both Arabic registers. A common rational denominator proves the finite-premise converse by structural induction; the explicit infinite dyadic-premise counterexample disproves the unrestricted version. The source satisfaction definitions impose no hidden finiteness condition. All formula tokens and frozen English remain unchanged, and finiteness is stated as sufficient rather than necessary.

Preserve the established Arabic term for designated truth value. Clarify in both Arabic registers that the theorem sequent contains A alone in designated positions and has all other positions empty, as follows from the adjacent derivability definition with no premises. This removes an ambiguity with initial sequents; it does not claim the intended calculus declares every formula a theorem. Preserve every mathematical token and the frozen English source.

In both Arabic registers distinguish necessarily possible from possibly necessary by explicit nested clauses matching the English operator order; these operators do not generally commute. Exact two-world and separating-frame examples support these scope decisions. Correct the consistency definition grammar and restrict the semantic observation to models in which the modal system is valid.
Cite the exact accessibility-characterization lemma and explicitly invoke the induction hypothesis before applying the semantic definition in the modal truth-lemma case.

Retain the effective finite-model-property qualification from 0452-I1; state filtration preservation with separate truth and falsity biconditionals in Classical (0452-I2); and separate the MSA finite-model-property truth and falsity cases so the finite model preserves the same truth value (0452-I3).
Type the filtration condition on the filtered model and require at least one filtration for every model before drawing the class-level satisfiability corollary.

Require prefix sets to be predecessor-closed and maintain that invariant in tableau soundness, which makes extension by a fresh prefix semantically valid; also standardize modal terminology.

Allow completed tableaux to have closed or complete branches, prove saturation terminates by modal depth and the finite subformula set, and separate the empty-premise case so the canonical model has a nonempty world set. Retain the terminology marker on the resulting tableau so the Classical paraphrase preserves the source term inventory.
Bound prefix generation by strictly decreasing modal depth and finite signed subformulas, while clarifying that each generative rule is applied once per signed formula and prefix.

Standardize the Arabic adjective for the modal operators in the rules for K.
Standardize modal terminology and repair the S5 frame-condition table so transitivity is identified as a consequence of reflexivity plus Euclideanness and Euclideanness occupies its own rule row.

This intentional MSA terminology correction is distinct from, and does not reinstate, the retracted Classical غير أنّا false positive.
Apply the retained epistemic-logic decision agent=فاعل consistently to all agent occurrences in the public-announcement language.
Expose the agent-indexed accessibility families in both model tuples, use agent=فاعل consistently, and correct the post-announcement evaluation world from the nonexistent primed label to w_1.

Require the prefix interpretation to respect every predecessor extension, add predecessor closure as a theorem invariant, and prove that extending the interpretation at a fresh prefix preserves all required accessibility relations.
Refer to the satisfaction definition itself when adding the counterfactual clause, rather than describing it as a definition of propositional formulas.

Quantify the stage principle over an arbitrary collection of previously formed sets and state its converse restriction without the broken plural construction.
Repair the Arabic superlative/genitive construction describing the absence of a universal set as one of the fundamental ideas of the iterative conception.
Prove asymmetry directly from the least-element property and then prove transitivity by identifying the least member of a three-element set; the old one-line transitivity inference was invalid.
Choose a bijection witnessing equal cardinality and state that its coordinatewise product map is itself bijective, completing the displayed cardinal-square proof.
Map alpha to W_{alpha+1}, the actual fixed point constructed at the successor stage, instead of W_alpha.
Exclude the empty prefix from the strict left-bracket surplus proposition, since the empty prefix has equal counts rather than a strict surplus.
Normalize recursion terminology in the biography to عودية and عودية بدائية, avoiding the inconsistent literal call/recall-derived forms.

Replace circular or invalid generalization arguments by finite-support proofs using fresh auxiliary constants, bijective constant renaming, explicit quantifier-rule applications, and a c-free change-of-bound-variable construction.
State the lexicographic cut-elimination measure in the order actually used—cut rank first, then height—and repair the malformed case-A sentence.
Handle separately the case with no quantifier inferences and justify that the bottom block of unary quantifier inferences forms one chain whose upper premise is a midsequent.

Use strong induction and choose the highest dirty eigenvariable inference, so the replaced subproof has fewer—not necessarily exactly one fewer—dirty inferences and its lower subproof is regular for the stated reason.
Rewrite the open-assumption definition so the scope of the tree segment and the absence of discharge are unambiguous.
Insert the contractions required when the same labelled assumption contributes duplicate antecedent occurrences, while preserving duplicates arising from distinct labels.

Distinguish semantic tableaux from truth tables throughout, use supported width-bounded tableau and proof-tree environments, and state the finite-branch exhaustion condition for the two non-marking quantified rules precisely.
Clarify that the four simulated rules are the four logical rules; weakening and contraction are discussed separately afterward.
Correct the replacement editorial path from content/method/proofs to the existing content/methods/proofs directory.

formal_repair_metadata.rationale: Split the cases x=0 and x=1 before choosing the largest prime not exceeding x, because no such prime exists in either exceptional case. The visible correction preserves the intended construction and deliberately changes the formula-token sequence.

Separate the universal condition governing entry of t from the universal condition governing entry of s, so that the condition on t is not vacuous when s is empty. The repaired statement deliberately changes the formula-token sequence.

Every natural number e is already an index, so the impossible non-index branch is removed while the total characteristic function h is retained. The correction deliberately changes the formula-token sequence.

State a standing choice rather than promising a later proof, and state that U extracts the result from the coded computation record. The transparent correction note and reordered formulas intentionally change the formula-token sequence while preserving the corrected argument.

The symbols e, a_i, and y_i denote natural numbers rather than one sequence. The explicit correction note introduces the corresponding formulas and therefore deliberately changes the formula-token sequence.

Pair projections alone do not certify that w is a valid pair code. Require the round trip w=< (w)_0,(w)_1 > and send invalid codes to a fixed z outside K1. This semantic repair deliberately changes the formula-token sequence.
Quantify the component functions exactly over i<k rather than using the ambiguous prose description rank or arity. The inserted exact inline range deliberately changes the formula-token sequence.

Robinson arithmetic Q proves not-A_g(k,n,0) from uniqueness in the functional representation together with the inequality of distinct numerals. The explicit repaired argument changes the formula-token sequence outside the separately declared Arabic-only intertext rephrasing.

The independently verified entailment repair makes the intended modal consequence condition explicit. Its current exact source/target comparison intentionally changes the ordered formula-token sequence and no other protected invariant.

For finite Delta, choose k as max{n:A_n is in Delta}, with k=2 in the empty case; equivalently choose k at least n for every member. This makes M_k satisfy the finite subset and deliberately changes the formula-token sequence.
